images.name: changelog
images.title: Lobbies
images.headline: 8s can now be created by Supporters and played by anyone
bullets: Host a lobby for right now or schedule it for later, others sign up and check in before it starts
Best-of sets played 4v4 with the teams reshuffled after every set
Turn on the weapon randomizer to roll 4 weapons per team every set, either **Chaotic** or **Balanced**
Extra players wait on the waitlist or spectate and rotate in when a spot opens up
Each lobby has its own leaderboard, separate from SendouQ
Keep a lobby public, share it only via an invite link or limit it to your associations

steps.title: Sign up & check in
steps.text: Join a lobby that's on right now or one scheduled for later. Check in before it starts.
steps.alt: Screenshot of a lobby with check-in open and a countdown to the start.

steps.title: Play best‑of sets
steps.text: 4v4 on maps picked from everyone's map preferences, like in SendouQ. Teams get reshuffled after every set.
steps.alt: Screenshot of the current map with the room password and both teams.

steps.title: Drop in & out
steps.text: Need to go? Mark that you leave after this set and someone from the waitlist takes your spot, so the lobby keeps going.
steps.alt: Screenshots of the "Leave after this set" button and the "A spot opened up, confirm you're ready to play!" prompt shown to the waitlist.

steps.title: Climb the leaderboard
steps.text: Every lobby keeps its own rankings, separate from SendouQ.
steps.alt: Screenshot of a lobby's rankings tab.

steps.title: Show it on your profile
steps.text: Your placement is saved when the lobby ends. Show them off with the Lobby Placements widget.
steps.alt: Screenshot of a user page with the widget showing 3 first, 2 second and 1 third place finishes from 6 lobbies.
